maxListings.title: Maximum listings to scrape
maxListings.description: Maximum number of listings to scrape (0 = all available). The API is paginated, so this limits total results.

priceMin.title: Minimum price filter (CZK)
priceMin.description: Minimum price filter in Czech Koruna. Applied after fetching data from API.

priceMax.title: Maximum price filter (CZK)
priceMax.description: Maximum price filter in Czech Koruna. Applied after fetching data from API.

location.title: Location filter
location.description: Optional location filter (district name). Applied after fetching data from API.

searchQuery.title: Search query filter
searchQuery.description: Optional search term to filter auction titles/descriptions. Applied after fetching data from API.

categoryId.title: Category ID filter
categoryId.description: Category filter (0 = all). Common: Pozemky, Stavby, etc.

includeTenders.title: Include other forms of sale and lease
includeTenders.description: Also scrape the site's "Jiné formy prodeje a pronájmu" offers (sale, gift, lease). Their ids are stored with a "T" prefix. maxListings counts auctions first, then tenders.

includeDetailedData.title: Fetch detail pages
includeDetailedData.description: Open every item's detail page for exact GPS (real-estate auctions), the contact person, phone and e-mail, all photos and the auction facts (minimum bid, deposit, registration deadline). A failed detail page keeps the list data.
